adverse_weather_tested_quote: the samples were divided into three categories: small smoke against cloudy backgrounds, small smoke under backlighting conditions, and thin or visually weak small smoke
false_positive_sources_analysed_quote: fog, mist, haze, dust, steam, and thin clouds may exhibit low contrast, diffuse boundaries, and semi-transparent visual patterns similar to early-stage smoke
deployment_level_quote: this result was obtained under a desktop-GPU setting. Therefore, it should be regarded as a practical inference-efficiency reference rather than direct evidence of onboard UAV deployment performance
failure_modes_reported_quote: The presented cases indicate that the proposed model still has difficulty detecting very weak small smoke and distinguishing it from smoke-like background interference under such combined conditions.
hyperparams_full_quote: The proposed model was initialized using the pre-trained weights of yolov10n.pt.
coder_notes: Best-documented split hygiene in the shard after the FIgLib paper: pHash near-duplicate screening is run BEFORE splitting and the authors state the purpose as reducing 'potential overlap among subsets', which is an explicit leakage acknowledgement. The mechanism of the 8:1:1 division itself is still not stated, hence ratio_only_mechanism_unstated and leakage_risk=medium rather than low. EXCERPT PARTLY INSUFFICIENT: Table 1 (per-split counts) and the Wildfire Smoke V1 result values are not reproduced, so n_train/n_val/n_test and cross_dataset_delta are not_reported; likewise the optimizer/epoch values are referred to but not printed, so hyperparams_full is partial. The paper is unusually explicit that its 87 FPS figure is desktop-GPU only and not evidence of onboard UAV performance. Conventions applied consistently across this shard: (1) dataset_public coded yes/partly only where the text itself states availability; not_reported where availability is never addressed. (2) n_train/n_val/n_test recorded only where an explicit integer is printed; percentages alone are left not_reported and captured in split_stated_verbatim. (3) leakage_risk=high reserved for a stated random/shuffled split of video- or burst-derived frames, or a stated same-site/event overlap; an unstated split mechanism is medium per the rubric's 'unclear split'. (4) real_wildfire_detected read operationally (did the deployed system detect an actual unplanned wildfire), so dataset-only and bench studies are coded no even when the imagery shows real fires. (5) link_resolves=not_checked throughout: links were not dereferenced in this round. (6) deployment_duration_days / n_nodes_or_cameras coded not_applicable for L0 dataset-only work.
